evidence.summary: Profile 0.18 declaration kinds identify functions and tests as callable declarations, but the index exposes no dynamic callable value or reflective typed invocation capability.

reproduction.instructions: MNCS_LIBRARY_PATH=mncs-test/native:mncs-language/library mncs-language/target/debug/mncs declaration-inventory mncs-test/tests/self_suite.mncs -> valid inventory with 7 exported test callables. The available mncs call route requires --module and --function; mncs test --test-identity selects static test declarations and accepts no heterogeneous callable-argument binding.

summary: Current Profile 0.18 verification confirms compiler inventory admission and typed signature material, but no generic MNCS callable-identity invocation surface. The test provider therefore retains transparent generated typed dispatch.

workaround.description: The compiler-inventory-bound generator emits explicit typed MNCS dispatch. It is not a semantic registry and remains fail-closed on inventory/signature identity mismatch.
